title: A week of every train in Berlin
description:
A week of every train in Berlin, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Berlin city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: U-Bahn, S-Bahn and Regional.

Busiest moment: 296 trains, Monday at 4:59 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable. October 24 and October 25 are left out because the clocks change. VBB changed its timetables during October and has fewer than three usable October Sundays, so its Thursday, Friday and Sunday each use one typical date.
